_comment: Committed classification of every ```sql block in 02/07 (plan 0.2 advertised_ddl_replay, #753). class=normative -> replayed; class=illustrative -> excluded with a reason. Keyed by content sha256: a block added/removed/edited in the plan falls out of this bijection and fails the ratchet gate (test_advertised_ddl.py) until re-classified by hand. 'illustrative' is a reviewed fact, never a regex guess. policy_expansion carries the two 7-DDL pattern lists the extractor GENERATES (13 tenant-plane + 2 user-plane = the 15 policies literal-only replay would leave absent, 02 0 line 35).

§32 planned stories are served on time or missed out loud (089, #1413) — the unconditional slot key dropped and the cadence-only key renamed to it (contract), fn_prompts_due re-created serving planned rows only while servable and in their late window and skipping every cancel-flagged row, fn_reaper_sweep replace whose slot expiry takes cadence rows only, and fn_planned_misses listing the planned rows that will not be served with their reason

§33 a removal sticks, and a removed admin's tokens go with them (090, readiness review 2026-10-02) — workspace_member_removals (tenant plane, written only by svc_membership), service_tokens.created_by_user_id, fn_group_member_seen refusing a removed non-member, and fn_member_remove recording the removal

§34 the Drive grant records who granted it (091, readiness review 2026-10-02) — oauth_credentials.granted_by_user_id, written by the Drive connect callback, so only the granter browses the Drive and picks folders from it

§35 a new account needs a way in while in beta (092, owner decision 2026-10-02) — signup_admissions (global, read only by svc_membership) and fn_signup_admitted, the door the sign-in upsert asks before it creates a user: an owner admission or a live invitation addressed to the verified email

§41 an invitation admits only while it is legitimate (098, owner decision, PR #1560 and #1574 security reviews) — fn_signup_admitted and fn_invitation_accept counting an invitation only from an active workspace whose owner or admin, with an active account, still sent it, the accept door refusing a person removed after the invitation (read again after its membership insert), a one-time revoke of the pending invitations of removed inviters and of those addressed to a person removed after they were sent, and svc_membership's column read of users' id and state under p_member_users

§42 a person can unlink their own Telegram identity (099) — fn_identity_unlink, owned by svc_membership and granted to svc_ingress, removing the user's telegram identity only while another identity remains, with svc_membership's SELECT and DELETE on user_identities under p_member_identities

§43 the waitlist is written by the API, not by the site (100, owner decision 2026-10-03) — waitlist_entries (global, RLS on, svc_ingress may INSERT and nothing else under p_ingress_waitlist), the address rule of §35 with a dot in the domain and no control, bidi-isolate, interlinear or tag characters, at most 254 characters, and a utm object bounded at 2 KB

§44 the outbox records why a delivery failed (101, #1482) — channel_outbox gains last_failure_class (checked against the five classes), last_error_code and last_failed_at with a partial index on the time, and two svc_maintenance doors: fn_health_outbox_failures counting the window's failures by class and code with their alerting subset, and fn_health_outbox_sent counting the window's sends

§45 a removal holds (102) — the runtime logins' SELECT on workspace_member_removals revoked and p_tenant_read dropped (the membership doors alone read and write it), earlier removals backfilled from the governance audit trail keeping any record the door wrote, §41's one-time invitation revoke repeated after the backfill so the pending invitations those removals outrank end revoked, fn_group_member_seen's search_path pinned with pg_temp last (ALTER FUNCTION … SET), and fn_member_remove replace that checks the claimed tenant and the remover's owner-or-admin role first

§46 every SECURITY DEFINER function pins search_path = pg_catalog, public, pg_temp, with pg_temp last (103) — one ALTER FUNCTION ... SET search_path per door, the 29 definer functions in public written out by signature, no body restated
